notes.title: Major Update 1.1
notes.content:
in this update we increased render quality and fixed all the bugs we found
increased cpu and gpu performance up to 3x.

notes.title: bug fix
notes.content: fixed drone bugs and targeting system improved,

notes.title: Shahed Drone
notes.content:
Added Drones System into game 

in some levels you can use up to 5 drones to save you from enemies.
each drones cost 200 money and has 2500 damage

notes.title: patch 2 , bug fixes and new features
notes.content:
fixed the bug in all maps.
fixed optimization bug. enemies was lagging
fixed music bug in main map and main menu
fixed starting money in all maps
fixed towers electric effect
added new effects in game
make controling better.

notes.title: bug fix and improvement
notes.content:
fixed disable towers not working after electric pulse,
balanced starting money on some missions,
improve cross hair visibility,
fixed massive hp for some bikes,
balance waves hp on some missions.
